blocks.text: The {{fact:f:E-2021-001.client}} docket is reconciled, and none of the pending response dates or fee windows is at risk. A few dates in the company's own tracking did not match the Patent Office record; we have docketed the official dates and will send you the corrected list this week.

Each open office action now has a one-page summary, and the response with the earliest due date is in draft. We have started reading the references cited against your claims in that application. Nothing we have seen so far changes the approach set out in our engagement letter.

We need a call of about an hour with the inventors on that application, within the next two weeks if possible, so that we can test our reading of the references before the draft comes to you for review. Separately, please tell us in writing whether the company wants a continuation recommendation on every application before allowance, or only on the ones you name.
If you suggest two or three times that suit the inventors, my colleagues copied here will send a short agenda ahead of the call.
